newsitem.title: GERMANY: SOCCER-VOGTS CALLS UP SOUTH AFRICAN-BORN DUNDEE.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-VOGTS CALLS UP SOUTH AFRICAN-BORN DUNDEE.

text.p: Germany coach Berti Vogts named South African-born Sean Dundee in his squad on Tuesday for a friendly against Israel on February 26, just two months after the Karlsruhe striker became a German citizen.
Dundee, the Bundesliga's top scorer this season with 14 goals to his name, applied for German citizenship using a special fast-track method for cases of "public interest".
His decision to apply for a German passport sparked outrage in his native country where politicians accused him of turning his back on South Africa and called for the move to be blocked.
Dundee faces competition from some big names for a berth alongside captain Juergen Klinsmann but his current form could be enough to at least earn him an appearance as a substitute.

"One of the things that's important for me is who's at the top of the scoring charts," Vogts told a news conference in Frankfurt. "I'm pleased there's so many forwards around. Time will tell who emerges from them."
Fredi Bobic of VfB Stuttgart, last season's Bundesliga top scorer, and Udinese's Oliver Bierhoff are likely to be Dundee's two main competitors for a place in Vogts's strike force.

Vogts must do without Dundee's Karlsruhe team-mate Thomas Haessler for the game in Tel Aviv. The midfielder is still recovering from an ankle injury which also kept him out of Germany's World Cup qualifier against Portugal in December.
The coach has warned against expecting too much from Dundee, whose application for citizenship was approved in December, at the start of his international career.
He told reporters on Tuesday he would have to get to know the player first.
"The important thing will be how Dundee fits into the team, how he trains, how he deals with our fast pace," he added.
Next week's match is the first between a united Germany and Israel, although West Germany beat Israel 2-0 in a friendly in Tel Aviv in 1987.
Goalkeepers - Andreas Koepke (Marseille), Oliver Kahn (Bayern Munich), Oliver Reck (Werder Bremen).

Defenders - Markus Babbel (Bayern Munich), Thomas Helmer (Bayern Munich), Juergen Kohler (Borussia Dortmund), Stephan Passlack (Borussia Moenchengladbach), Stefan Reuter (Borussia Dortmund), Matthias Sammer (Borussia Dortmund), Thomas Schneider (VfB Stuttgart), Christian Woerns (Bayer Leverkusen).

Midfielders - Mario Basler (Bayern Munich), Marco Bode (Werder Bremen), Dieter Eilts (Werder Bremen), Joerg Heinrich (Borussia Dortmund), Andreas Moeller (Borussia Dortmund), Mehmet Scholl (Bayern Munich), Thomas Strunz (Bayern Munich), Michael Tarnat (Karlsruhe), Dariusz Wosz (Bochum), Christian Ziege (Bayern Munich).
Forwards - Oliver Bierhoff (Udinese), Fredi Bobic (VfB Stuttgart), Sean Dundee (Karlsruhe), Heiko Herrlich (Borussia Dortmund), Ulf Kirsten (Bayer Leverkusen), Juergen Klinsmann (Bayern Munich).
